title: Who may make will.
partHeading: PART 5. WILLS, WILL CONTRACTS, AND CUSTODY AND DEPOSIT OF WILLS
bodyText:
PART 5. WILLS, WILL CONTRACTS, AND CUSTODY AND DEPOSIT OF WILLS

An individual eighteen or more years of age who is of sound mind may make a will.
bodyHtml:
PART 5.  WILLS, WILL CONTRACTS, AND CUSTODY AND DEPOSIT OF WILLS

 

     §560:2-501  Who may make will.  An individual eighteen or more years of age who is of sound mind may make a will. [L 1996, c 288, pt of §1]
